title: David becomes king over Judah and Ish-bosheth over Israel
description: After Saul's death, David asks the Lord where he should go and is led to Hebron. There, the men of Judah anoint him king over the house of Judah, and David sends thanks to the men of Jabesh in Gilead for burying Saul. Meanwhile, Abner takes Saul's son Ish-bosheth to Mahanaim and makes him king over the rest of Israel. David rules in Hebron for seven years and six months.
